name: threatgate
description: ThreatGate — reverse-proxy Web Application Firewall with a live dashboard

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n waf+api,site,ui -c red,yellow,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run target --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
